summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of the Second Tranche of its share buyback program (Program Scheme), acquiring 52,800,888 shares (0.94% of capital) for €1,000 million at market prices. The buyback is for capital reduction via share redemption. Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG acted as manager. This is a capital return to shareholders. No stated premium, board recommendation, or regulatory timeline beyond redemption expectation. Watch for execution of share cancellation and impact on EPS/capital ratios, though no arbitrage angle exists given open-market purchases.
